description:
Inspect exactly one Base or Ethereum transaction, address, or contract with bounded read-only RPC calls and return deterministic context, observed signals, evidence, coverage, and recommended follow-up.
USE WHEN: agent needs broader deterministic investigation of a transaction hash, EVM address, or contract address.
DO NOT USE WHEN: agent only needs a single read-only smart-contract call; use Blockchain Intelligence instead.
Parameter semantics: `chain` is required; exactly one of `transaction_hash`, `address`, or `contract_address` must be provided.
name: blockchain_intelligence

classification.description: Observed deterministic target classification, not a safety assessment.

coverage.description: Explicitly records the observed RPC scope and unobserved categories.

risk_signals.description: Observed signals only; no risk score is assigned.

title: STRAELO Blockchain Intelligence
